question: In a certain code language, ‘CHOICE’ is written as ‘OHCECI’ and ‘DEMAND’ is written as ‘MEDDNA’. How will ‘EXPECT’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a827e903e52c199d8cea030f3655db9b02da63af4503920b2e34c4d18d2c5d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**Word is divided into two half parts and each half part is written backwards.**

 
• In CHOICE ​
